main_text.p: pro Cæsare expediunda, ab his Vien-nam in aulam abiit. Illic, ex sententia confecto negotio, reversus cum collega Steinbergio in Frisiam anno M. CCCC. LXXXI. inchoante, ( ardebat quippe ne-gotii studio ) diploma secum tulit amplif-simum in commodum ac honorem civi-tatis, & cum hoc fidei & mandati literas ad senatum, aliasque item ad omnes Diplo- ma Cae- faris, qui Oftergoae & Wester- goe guber- natio Gro- ninganis committi- tur,Translavicanæ regionis Ordines. In di- plomate sic scriptum fuit: Oftergoam Westergoamque, & quæ cum his cohærent trans Lavicam fl. sine controversia Imperatoris ac Imperii esse: & has propterea quod procul dissitæ à sede Imperatoris sint, nec ab eo absente curari bene possint, tumultibus atque aliis factionum malis perpetuò premi atterique, idcirco Imperatorem non precibus cujusquam, non ulla alia re, sed solo ipsarum regionum commodo permotum, sponte suâ, re bene consideratâ Consulibus senatuique Groningano optimè de Rep. communi meritis, & vicinia ipsa ad rem opportunis gubernandas eas tradere, munusque illud, quod POTESTATEM vocant, perpetuum tribuere cum omnibus, quæ muneri cohærent

page.notes: Long s is rendered as plain s. Roman numerals are set in capitals. The printed hyphens at line ends are kept. The "cc" ditto marks running down the right margin are repeat marks, not text, and are left out of the side note. The margin note reads as printed in the order of its lines. The final line of the text is followed by the catchword and signature.
